result.summary: The page is generally coherent, but horizontally scrolling content is visibly clipped at the right edge and the fixed bottom navigation overlaps the next restaurant card.

issues.description: The category carousel and the “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel show partially cut-off pills, images, and text at the right edge. The clipped “Trattoria Piccol…” card and partial category pill can look like broken overflow rather than intentional horizontal scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel affordance and consistent right-side padding, or constrain the carousel so cards are fully visible within the viewport.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the lower restaurant card, cutting off its content and making the card appear truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page or ensure the final card can scroll fully above the fixed navigation bar.
